proposal.summary: Stored cross-site scripting in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) < 3.5.3 allows an administrator who can configure settings to inject specially crafted settings that cause arbitrary script execution in the web browser of another administrator viewing the product.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

AV.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product

PR.quote: If a user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege configures specially crafted settings, an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review a proof-of-concept or reproduction steps showing the crafted settings and the resulting script execution in an admin user's browser; confirm exact affected endpoints and whether non-admin users can be impacted.
